answer: Each identity must maintain a 12-epoch route through independently operated relays. A beacon assigns four relays after commitment; every hop signs latency and payload hashes. Accounts from one funding karst face a widening route: the kth alias needs 4k unique hops, so 100 fakes require 20,200 relay services. At dawn, validators replay signatures against the public anchor map; one reused hop or forged delay burns a 50-POA bond and restarts the cluster.
